```
URLs --> fetchFeeds --> parseItems --> dedupe --> sort(by date) --> Items[]

- **merge.js** — orchestrates fetch -> parse -> dedupe -> sort and threads errors to the caller.

## Data shape

Every stage speaks the same `Item`: `{ guid, title, link, published: Date, source }`; after dedupe each item also carries `sources: string[]`.
